page.layout: One page, no printed text on this side. The visible letters are show-through from the reverse side, mirrored and faint.
page.notes: No running text, heading, page number or catchword can be read as printed on this side. The faint, mirrored lines in the upper half (a heading reading "IMPRIMATVR", numbered items in Latin, and a line reading "FINIS:" lower down) are show-through from the other side and are not transcribed. Below them is a faint ornament, probably show-through as well, though it may be a printer's device; it is not transcribed. Stains and speckling across the page are also not transcribed.
